violation_type.title: Children Handwashing After Feeding or Touching Animals (26 TAC §747.3213(6))
violation_type.short_title: Children Handwashing After Feeding or Touching Animals
violation_type.typical_finding: Children hands were not washed after eating or diapering. Note: when pointed out the children's hands were washed.

finding_variants.text: Children hands were not washed after eating or diapering. Note: when pointed out the children's hands were washed.
A child was observed touching an animal, and did not wash their hands. This was corrected during the inspection when the primary caregiver asked the child washed their hands.
